verses.pali: “Yasmiṁ, bhikkhave, samaye corā balavanto honti, rājāno tasmiṁ samaye dubbalā honti.
verses.english: “At a time when bandits are strong, kings are weak.

verses.pali: Tasmiṁ, bhikkhave, samaye rañño na phāsu hoti atiyātuṁ vā niyyātuṁ vā paccantime vā janapade anusaññātuṁ.
verses.english: Then the king is not at ease when going out or coming back or when touring the provinces.

verses.pali: Brāhmaṇagahapatikānampi tasmiṁ samaye na phāsu hoti atiyātuṁ vā niyyātuṁ vā bāhirāni vā kammantāni paṭivekkhituṁ.
verses.english: The brahmins and householders, likewise, are not at ease when going out or coming back, or when inspecting their external business activities.

verses.pali: Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, yasmiṁ samaye pāpabhikkhū balavanto honti, pesalā bhikkhū tasmiṁ samaye dubbalā honti.
verses.english: In the same way, at a time when bad mendicants are strong, good-hearted mendicants are weak.

verses.pali: Tasmiṁ, bhikkhave, samaye pesalā bhikkhū tuṇhībhūtā tuṇhībhūtāva saṅghamajjhe saṅkasāyanti paccantime vā janapade acchanti.
verses.english: Then the good-hearted mendicants continually adhere to silence in the midst of the Saṅgha, or they stay in the borderlands.

verses.pali: Tayidaṁ, bhikkhave, hoti bahujanāhitāya bahujanāsukhāya, bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṁ.
verses.english: This is for the detriment and suffering of the people, against the people, for the harm, detriment, and suffering of gods and humans.

verses.pali: Yasmiṁ, bhikkhave, samaye rājāno balavanto honti, corā tasmiṁ samaye dubbalā honti.
verses.english: At a time when kings are strong, bandits are weak.

verses.pali: Tasmiṁ, bhikkhave, samaye rañño phāsu hoti atiyātuṁ vā niyyātuṁ vā paccantime vā janapade anusaññātuṁ.
verses.english: Then the king is at ease when going out or coming back or when inspecting the provinces.

verses.pali: Brāhmaṇagahapatikānampi tasmiṁ samaye phāsu hoti atiyātuṁ vā niyyātuṁ vā bāhirāni vā kammantāni paṭivekkhituṁ.
verses.english: The brahmins and householders, likewise, are at ease when going out or coming back, or when inspecting their external business activities.

verses.pali: Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, yasmiṁ samaye pesalā bhikkhū balavanto honti, pāpabhikkhū tasmiṁ samaye dubbalā honti.
verses.english: In the same way, at a time when good-hearted mendicants are strong, bad mendicants are weak.

verses.pali: Tasmiṁ, bhikkhave, samaye pāpabhikkhū tuṇhībhūtā tuṇhībhūtāva saṅghamajjhe saṅkasāyanti, yena vā pana tena pakkamanti.
verses.english: Then the bad mendicants continually adhere to silence in the midst of the Saṅgha, or they leave for some place or other.

verses.pali: Tayidaṁ, bhikkhave, hoti bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya, bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānan”ti.
verses.english: This is for the welfare and happiness of the people, for the people, for the benefit, welfare, and happiness of gods and humans.”
